description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Minor Material Amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/24/136123) dated 17 October 2024 for the variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) at 1-1A Davenport Road SE6, in order to allow:Reconfiguration of general site soft and hard landscaping including consolidated bicycle storage for Block B; Alterations to Block A - removal of canopy roof, increase in third floor frontprint on front elevation, reduction in number of PV panels and extent of green roof, and installation of roof access hatch and vent, change from zinc cladding to silver-grey brick, balcony soffit changed to anthracite grey, alterations to third floor fenestration;Alterations to Block B - reconfiguration of layout to remove second floor and terraces and reduce size of units including alterations to footprint, change zinc cladding to silver brick, roof changed to liquid membrane with associated removal of green roof / PV panels, alterations to fenestrationOther minor associated works.
